mapper.insert: insert into _pet(pet_id, member_id, pet_src, pet_name, pet_gender, pet_color, pet_type, pet_code, pet_etc_breed, pet_birthdate, pet_adopdate) values(#{pet_id}, #{member_id}, #{pet_src}, #{pet_name}, #{pet_gender}, #{pet_color}, #{pet_type}, #{pet_code}, #{pet_etc_breed}, #{pet_birthdate}, #{pet_adopdate})
mapper.select: select interest.*, p.product_id, p.product_name, i.* from _interest interest join _products p on interest.product_id = p.product_id join _image i on p.product_id = i.image_id where interest.member_id = #{member_id}
mapper.insert: insert into _review(member_id, product_id, order_detail_option_id, review_rate, review_content) values(#{member_id}, #{product_id}, #{order_detail_option_id}, #{review_rate}, #{review_content})

insert into _product_inquiry(member_id, product_id, order_detail_option_id, inquiry_type, inquiry_content) values(#{member_id}, #{product_id}, #{order_detail_option_id}, #{inquiry_type}, #{inquiry_content})
mapper.select: select count(*) from _orders where member_id = #{member_id} and status not in ('임시저장', '취소종료', '취소', '환불', '반품', '구매확정')
